use.flag: Install FaucetPlugin (OpenFlow SDN controller support — rarely used)

pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Proxmox VE SDN (Software-Defined Networking) Perl library. Manages overlay networks (VLAN, VxLAN, EVPN/BGP, QinQ, WireGuard fabrics) and IPAM.
This package provides the SDN configuration layer only. It generates /etc/network/interfaces.d/sdn snippets. Applying those snippets to the host requires either ifupdown2 (Debian) or the Gentoo network backend plugin (net-misc/pve-network-backend). See docs/packages/pve-network-moddoc.md.
Host bridge management (vmbr0 etc.) is in libpve-common-perl, not here.
